dct_description_sm: Data to support "Next Stop Health: Transit Access and Health Inequities in Toronto".  This is the hourly avg. of the number of stops at each stop between 7am and 8pm. It is this that we then use to calculate the transit score for various geographies.  We have done dissemination areas, census tracts and the grid you saw, but can aggregate to different geographies as well.
